rules.meaning: TCGplayer names the Duel Terminal parallel finish 'Duel Terminal Technology Common/Ultra Rare'. YGOPRODeck names it 'Duel Terminal Normal Parallel Rare' / 'Duel Terminal Ultra Parallel Rare'. Both describe the same physical finish on the same HAC1-EN cards. Taxonomy correspondence only; no edition or artwork authority.

sourceRarityAliases.meaning: YGOPRODeck labels some Commons by pack ratio. A Short Print or Super Short Print is physically a Common, as Konami set lists and TCGplayer file it, so the label corresponds only to a product sold as Common. Taxonomy only; no edition, artwork or pricing authority.

commonShortPrintPairs.decision: Count the reviewed Common and Short Print labels as one Common finish when the exact English TCGplayer product, supported edition lanes, and both YGOPRODeck rows agree with the Konami checklist.
